notes.title: Patch Release Announcement(8/25)
notes.content:
Language settings now take place via Steam.
After installing the patch, please follow the steps below to change your game’s language settings:
1. Select The Legend of Heroes: Zero no Kiseki from the Steam client library.
2. Click "Manage" (gear icon) and open "Properties".
3. Select the desired language from the "Language" menu.

Other minor bugs fixed.
